{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Max\allowbreak{}Seek\allowbreak{}Rate\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 2.\allowbreak{}0} & Maximum seek strain-rate norm divided by the prescribed/reference strain-rate norm.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Max\allowbreak{}Seek\allowbreak{}Strain} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 5.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}2} & Maximum accumulated seek strain before a compressive target is declared unreachable.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Max\allowbreak{}Seek\allowbreak{}Strain\allowbreak{}Increment} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}4} & Maximum absolute stress-control strain increment in one step during adaptive/seek control.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Min\allowbreak{}Strain\allowbreak{}Rate} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}30} & Minimum reference strain rate for adaptive stress control when no prescribed deformation rate is active.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Reengage\allowbreak{}Ramp\allowbreak{}Strain} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 5.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}3} & Macroscopic strain interval over which seek mode is blended back to adaptive active control.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Reengage\allowbreak{}Tangent\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 5.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}3} & Fraction of initial tangent scale needed to re-engage active control after seek mode.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Response\allowbreak{}Strain} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}2} & Macroscopic strain interval over which adaptive stress control removes filtered stress error.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Seek\allowbreak{}Rate\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}5} & Bounded seek strain-rate ratio used while a compressive target has no load path.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Solver\allowbreak{}Damping\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 5.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}2} & Damping used in the small damped least-squares solve for active adaptive stress control.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Stress\allowbreak{}Floor} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}0} & Stress floor used in adaptive stress-control ratios. If zero, a target-based floor is used.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Tangent\allowbreak{}Ceiling\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e2} & Upper bound for learned tangent diagonals as a fraction of the initial tangent scale.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Tangent\allowbreak{}Floor\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}3} & Lower bound for learned tangent diagonals as a fraction of the initial tangent scale.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Wave\allowbreak{}Cutback\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}1} & Raw-minus-filtered stress ratio above which tangent adaptation remains frozen during re-engagement.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Control\allowbreak{}Wave\allowbreak{}Warn\allowbreak{}Ratio} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 5.\allowbreak{}0e-\allowbreak{}2} & Raw-minus-filtered stress ratio that warns about inertial/wave dominated stress control.\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Table} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}} & Array that stores the time-depended grid aligned stresses\\
{\ttfamily stress\allowbreak{}Table\allowbreak{}Interp\allowbreak{}Type} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily Linear} & The type of stress table interpolation. Options are 0 (linear), 1 (cosine), 2 (quintic polynomial).\\
{\ttfamily subdivide\allowbreak{}Particles} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}1} & Particle subdivision policy: -1 selects the automatic default, 0 disables subdivision, and 1 enables it. Automatic subdivision is enabled only for vpHencky CPDI domain scaling with linear CPDI shape functions; it remains disabled for B-spline particles and deformation-gradient reset alone.\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Detection} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Flag for automatic surface detection on the 1st cycle\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Normal\allowbreak{}And\allowbreak{}Position\allowbreak{}Damage\allowbreak{}Threshold} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}9999} & Sets the damage threshold at which explicit particle surface normals, positions, and tractions are disabled\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Quality\allowbreak{}Threshold} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}0} & Minimum mapping-normal tensor quality required for same-group DFG separability. Valid range is [0,1]; 0 disables the quality restriction and 1 requires a fully coherent, fully covered normal.\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Tension\allowbreak{}Force\allowbreak{}Sign} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 1.\allowbreak{}0} & Sign multiplier for the grid continuum-surface-stress force. Leave at +1; set to -1 only when validating against an opposite normal/color convention.\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Tension\allowbreak{}Gradient\allowbreak{}Tolerance} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}0} & Lower bound for |grad color| used to regularize surface-tension normals. Units are inverse length. A non-positive value selects an automatic value.\\
{\ttfamily surface\allowbreak{}Tension\allowbreak{}Pairs} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}} & Rows of \{ phaseA, phaseB, gamma \}. Phases are particleGroup/contact-group ids. Use phaseB=-1 for a phase-void/free-surface pair. gamma has units of force/length.\\
{\ttfamily thin\allowbreak{}Feature\allowbreak{}DFGThreshold} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily DBL\_\allowbreak{}MAX} & Suppresses DFG separability when the squared distance between field centers is less than (thinFeatureDFGThreshold * neighborRadius)\textasciicircum{}2.\\
{\ttfamily time\allowbreak{}Integration\allowbreak{}Option} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily Explicit\allowbreak{}Dynamic} & Time integration method. Options are:; * ; *\\
{\ttfamily total\allowbreak{}Binder\allowbreak{}Volume} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}0} & Total volume of binder\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}Coordinates} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}} & Coordinates used to initialize MPM lagrangian tracers. Each row is x,y,z; each tracer follows the nearest particle selected during initialization.\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}Cycle\allowbreak{}Interval} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Cycle interval for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. Use either tracerCycleInterval or tracerWriteInterval. A value of 0 means no cycle-based interval.\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}History} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Flag to enable MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. One CSV file is written per tracer point.\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}Output\allowbreak{}Prefix} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily "tracer\allowbreak{}Point"} & Filename prefix for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV files.\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}Variables} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily -\allowbreak{}} & Particle variables to write to each MPM lagrangian tracer CSV file. Supported names include particleID, mass, volume, materialType, porosity, density, damage, temperature, internalEnergy, kineticEnergy, speed, velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ, plasticStrainMagnitude, stressXX, stressYY, stressZZ, stressYZ, stressXZ, stressXY, and plasticStrainXX/YY/ZZ/YZ/XZ/XY.\\
{\ttfamily tracer\allowbreak{}Write\allowbreak{}Interval} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0.\allowbreak{}0} & Time interval for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. Use either tracerWriteInterval or tracerCycleInterval. A value of 0 means no time-based interval.\\
{\ttfamily update\allowbreak{}Method} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily FLIP} & Update method. Options are:; * ; *\\
{\ttfamily update\allowbreak{}Order} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 2} & Order for update method, only applies to XPIC and FMPM\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Crack\allowbreak{}Tip\allowbreak{}Detection} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Set to activate crack-tip detection and distance calc\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Events} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Enable events\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Internal\allowbreak{}Force\allowbreak{}As\allowbreak{}Face\allowbreak{}Reaction} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Will use internal force component at boundary node as reaction\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Node\allowbreak{}Pos\allowbreak{}For\allowbreak{}Area} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Option to compute nodal area from grid surface normals and positions (results may be inaccurate if implicit surface normals and positiosn are used)\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Reference\allowbreak{}Vectors\allowbreak{}For\allowbreak{}Particle\allowbreak{}Update} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Flag for determining the integration scheme of particle vector attributes\\
{\ttfamily use\allowbreak{}Surface\allowbreak{}Position\allowbreak{}For\allowbreak{}Contact} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Flag for to use particle mapped surface positions in contact calculations\\
{\ttfamily write\allowbreak{}Particle\allowbreak{}Data} & {\ttfamily OPTIONAL} & {\ttfamily 0} & Flag to enable writing particle data to file\\
\end{longtable}
}
